name: MuBank bonds MU and MUG at the live pair quote
summary: MuBank.mu_bond and mu_gold_bond sell the bank's MU and MUG for an approved stablecoin at a quote computed from the live reserves of the Trader Joe USDC.e/MU and MU/MUG pairs. Inside a flash swap of nearly all MU in the MU/MUG pair, the attacker dumped that MU into the USDC.e/MU pair, then bonded 3,300 and 6,990 USDC.e. The bank paid 99,102.20 MU and 9,640.24 MUG, about seven hours after deployment.
notes: Owner setMuMoneyAddress(0x1713bcaf63fd615f4fde8d025326ce0948ebccdb). Both bond functions end with MuMoneyMinter(_MuMoney).mint(address(this), amount). The constructor default 0x5ea63080e67925501c5c61b9c0581dbd87860019 reverts that mint for the bank with "Only the Mu Bank can mint new Mu Money", so the bond path worked only after this write.

MuBank's MU and MUG paid out in the exploit transaction. The attacker's disposal moved both prices, so both are valued at realised proceeds. The final sale of 259,460.063432951156943008 MU returned 57,659.463903 USDC.e, which is 0.222229 USD per MU with USDC.e at par (DefiLlama 0.99949). MUG is valued through its sale for 180,974.292926286893962912 MU, which is 18.7728 MU per MUG. That gives 62,241.03 USD gross. The 10,290 USDC.e the attacker paid into the bank for the two bonds is netted. The attacker's MU round trip through the USDC.e/MU pair is a cost borne by pair LPs and is not counted. DefiLlama's pre-exploit MU spot of 0.645 USD is not used because the disposal moved the price. The seed row and DeFiHackLabs give ~57k USD, the attacker's USDC.e profit.
